anchor.semantic_hook: Coming at a gallop is made literal by an arrivals conveyor carried forward on four galloping horse legs.
anchor.setting: A multipurpose arrivals hall contains a broad receiving bay, a work counter, a garden strip, and a meeting table. A single long conveyor crosses the hall on four enormous horse legs that gallop without moving from the floor, rushing each incoming thing toward the receiving bay. All other fixtures are ordinary and still.
